purpose: The frozen baseline the AGI roadmap measures against: what this mind is scored by today, with each number tagged by whether it was re-run for this manifest or is cited from the experiment ledger. Written read-only, before any roadmap phase is built, so later lift is measured against a record that predates it.
non_claims: None of these suites is a generality benchmark. They score machinery, not intelligence.
No suite here has a held-out domain split, an anti-memorization variant, or a human baseline. Phase A-I add those; their absence is the point of this baseline.
No number here is cost- or latency-normalised. Nothing in this repository is, yet.
Suites marked evidence:ledger were NOT re-run for this manifest; they are quoted from the entry named, which recorded them when they were run.

workspace.note: The whole-workspace count is a regression floor, not a capability measure. It is recorded because a roadmap phase that lowers it has broken something.

suites.scores: The coverage router: which expertise pack a query should lease, and when it should abstain.

corpus.authored: From the packs' own coverage lists and descriptions, BEFORE the router ran on anything.

suites.known_weakness: The labels are not independent of the coverage authors (same lineage), so this bar measures self-consistency, not correctness. Stated in the suite's own header.

suites.scores: Whether the executive's vocabulary can REPRESENT a set of hand-authored decisions. Representability, not correctness.
suites.known_weakness: Representability is a floor, not a capability: a decision the vocabulary can express may still be decided wrongly. Nothing here has ever controlled live behaviour.

suites.known_weakness: BENCHMARKED and never reachable: no live decision consults it.

suites.scores: An adversarial critic whose objective is to invalidate high-impact beliefs — cognition between exams, rather than the exam.
suites.note: Requires an external critic model; no frozen corpus.

suites.scores: The agentic loop's machinery — tool dispatch, observation feedback, the loop guard, budget/termination, failed-tool recovery, grounding — deterministically, independent of model quality.
suites.note: Runs unconditionally in the workspace count above.

suites.scores: Model-dependent cognition against a configured backend.
suites.note: Model-dependent; excluded from any regression floor by design.

Of 15 defects I introduced, 6 were caught by my own tests or mutations, 2 by the full workspace suite, and 7 survived every filter I own and were caught only by deploying and looking -- 47%. Severity of those 7: five cosmetic, one materially misleading, one operational and irreversible. Deliberately NOT claimed: that peer review would have caught any of them.

event_schema_gaps.note: Phase A. Measured against mind_observability::DecisionEvent as it exists at the baseline commit.
partial: goal_id propagates GoalSpec.id through compilation, bounded-run tool spans, contribution grades, refusals, and completion; ym why goals measures coverage, while legacy free-form turns remain unstamped
semantic_success is emitted for tool observations, goal-contribution grades, and pack-evidence grades; ym why semantics measures coverage by outcome kind

lane is explicit on compilation, bounded-run completion/refusal, shadow-route events, both tool loops, and goal-contribution grades as primary|member; ym why lanes measures stamped versus missing events

context_fingerprint is a domain-separated opaque hash shared by compilation, bounded-run completion/refusal, tool prediction/observation, and goal-contribution grades; ym why contexts measures coverage across those families without printing identifiers, while other decision families remain unstamped

latency_ms is emitted by both execution loops for tool calls, compilation, and completed bounded runs; ym why latency measures tool coverage/distribution and ym why resources separates compile and bounded-run wall time, while grounding-assembly and legacy full-turn latency remain unstamped

model_calls records one logical compilation request separately from end-to-end bounded-run requests (decision, replan, synthesis, configured grounding); the latter enforce one hard ceiling and ym why resources reports both phases, while provider failover attempts, tokens, and monetary cost remain absent
tool_version stamps the mind-conversation dispatcher crate/version on both tool loops; ym why versions measures coverage, while per-capability implementation versions remain absent

compilation, bounded cognitive runs, and both tool loops stamp configured model routes and ym why models measures coverage; explicit YM_ROLE_* pools retain provider:model instead of scripted, while actual serving-link model identity remains absent

tool, evidence-use, pack, and forecast grades stamp versioned evaluator identities; forecasts distinguish ledger-receipt-v1 from grounded-forecast-judge-v1; ym why evaluators measures stamped versus missing outcome grades

all aggregate ym why analytics require a fully verified decision-log hash chain; ym why chains measures complete prediction-observation provenance over the latest 200 tool calls, including orphan observations, predictions that never closed, and duplicate observation cardinality, and no live baseline has been captured yet

inference spend (L4-0, inference-ledger-v1): one terminal row per LOGICAL inference request at the pool seam — refused / failed / served, provider attempts at a stated observable boundary (chain links and leaf invocations; hidden transport retries excluded), latency, lane, selected route, served-by link, static callsite and the loop opportunity id when the host set one; ym why spend measures requests and attempts per callsite, per loop and per hour; tokens are ABSENT on every row until a backend reports them with provenance, and the loop ledger's model_calls stays None (never inferred from the budget)

metric_definitions.note: Every rate is published with the denominator an adversary would accept, and with its observation rate beside it (Doctrine 2).

metrics.name: attach harm
metrics.formula: corpus rows clearing the floor / no-pack queries, library mounted

metrics.name: pack local efficacy
metrics.formula: graded-good / graded, shown with surfaced, used and censoring = 1 - graded/used

metrics.name: lease precision
metrics.formula: leases whose pack evidence was used / leases granted
metrics.caveat: the used-proxy is word overlap, not causal use

metrics.name: tool reliability
metrics.formula: successes / calls that count toward reliability
metrics.caveat: Malformed and Denied are excluded in both directions by design
